instructions: agent_assessment is the first reviewer's research recommendation. label is the owner-delegated adjudication (label_by). null label = unresolved, never counted as correct. The 100-row denominator is unchanged.

methodology.census_method: Street-address batch geocoding with units removed and road spellings expanded; input/output preserved. Coordinates interpolate street ranges, not rooftop ground truth.
methodology.temporal_limit: Web evidence may postdate the 2026-08-19 source release; current pages do not prove release-time status. Historical and current evidence are distinguished in notes.
methodology.scope: All 43 candidate pairs and 45 flagged sample rows. The other 55 sample rows retain automated corroboration only, not manual acceptance.
methodology.ok_meaning: Address/pin corroboration supporting saved point. Moderate confidence unless an official business pin is available; not proof of rooftop accuracy, current operation, or independent upstream data.
methodology.wrong_meaning: Supported recorded-address/coordinate conflict. Not an approved replacement coordinate, automatic correction, or final owner label.
methodology.unresolved_meaning: Evidence insufficient or conflicting. Notes identify follow-up; not counted as correct.
methodology.sample_hand_check: 2026-09-28, owner-delegated. Each of the 55 unflagged rows: the cached Nominatim response from the original audit (var/audits/s6-20260928/geocode) re-measured against the saved point, plus web evidence for the business at that address (official pages fetched where noted; otherwise search-result listings). Every one of the 100 rows was searched for twins in venues.json (see label_criteria). No business was contacted and no imagery was inspected.

label_criteria.geocode_ok: The venue's address (or pin) is corroborated by business, municipal or marketplace evidence, and an official business pin or an independent geocoder match of that address lies within 150 m of the saved point (the audit's own tolerance, DEFAULT_GEOCODE_TOLERANCE_M). Where Nominatim and Census disagree, the source within tolerance decides only when the address is corroborated; this packet shows both geocoders missing official pins (Dutch Bros, Buenos Sabores).
label_criteria.geocode_wrong: The address is corroborated, nothing indicates the venue moved, and the saved point is more than 1,000 m from an official business pin or an independent geocoder match of that address. 1,000 m is well beyond the largest Census error measured against an official pin in this packet (575 m, Dutch Bros), so street-range interpolation cannot explain it.
label_criteria.geocode_unresolved: Anything else: 150-1,000 m discrepancies backed only by interpolating geocoders, no geocoder match, an uncorroborated address or venue, or evidence of a move/address conflict. Not counted as correct.
label_criteria.duplicate: Two or more current venue records represent the same operating outlet at the same time: same brand (legal/trading/label name variants included) at the same address. Proximity alone never decides it.
label_criteria.distinct: Evidence identifies separate outlets or separate brands.
label_criteria.duplicate_unresolved: Rename versus succession cannot be separated (under ADR-0012 a succession is a new business and the defect is lifecycle, not duplication), virtual-brand granularity is undecided, or a candidate twin's identity is unconfirmed.
label_criteria.sample_duplicate: A sampled row is a duplicate when some other current record in the 9,996-venue export represents the same outlet. Every sampled row was searched in the export: same house-number street line or name similarity >= 0.6 within 300 m, same fingerprint within 1 km, and same address at any distance. The audit detector alone is not sufficient: it misses twins with a misplaced coordinate and chain location-label records (e.g. Whataburger 'Main St & I-35').
